data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 海边的成熟邀请·「愣着做什么，帮你涂防晒是报酬」
data.description: 【湘南海岸·夏日】石榴红的连体泳装衬得诗羽的成熟曲线一览无余。她背对着你坐在沙地上，把白发箍递到手里把玩，金色的阳光洒在她拉开的后颈拉链上——「愣着做什么。拉链够不到……帮你涂防晒是报酬的一部分哦，前辈可是很会给后辈添麻烦的♪」
data.action: 背身坐在沙滩拉开背链，递白发箍，红瞳回头挑眉
data.camera: medium shot, sitting on sand, zipper request, teasing mood
data.promptProse: Utaha Kasumigaoka sits on the beach with her back partly toward her companion, gesturing to the swimsuit zipper she cannot reach. Her garnet-red one-piece, white hip sarong and hair tied with a white band remain consistent with the selected outfit. The medium view includes sand ripples and bright sea behind. Strong sunshine illuminates the zipper pull and hairband, while reflected water light softens the shade beneath her bent arm.
